objective: Integrate exact 1,300 existing Character System collectible graphics and authenticated task evidence into the existing per-character progression UI; preserve separate Kingdom economy, existing points and AdMob without production changes.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main at 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 on November 16, 2026 before this isolated DEV task; live Supabase preinspection found existing authenticated character V3 checkpoint, core item state RPC, special badge awards and no special story-item RPC or public art bucket. No new changes applied to production.
chosenApproach: Canonical all-13 Character task ledger, independent V3-saved Core XP, preserved legacy Core redeemed items, and vetted 1300-item art. Kingdom remains read-only consumer; do not edit economy.
selectionRationale: Alternative client-side XP or invented collectible ownership risks resets, fraud and cross-account leaks. Server-backed independent character checkpoints, validated task events, and distinct badges/story items prevent that.
alternativeApproaches: Bundle 1,300 full-size PNG sheets in Expo OTA: rejected due to runtime, size and performance.
Award all five stage items merely on level-up: rejected because level achievement is not verified item completion.
Copy Kingdom local game previews into the official reward ledger: rejected due to lack of authenticated evidence.
preserveBehaviors: Existing R31/R40 character art/selector hash locks are byte-for-byte unchanged; saved per-character V3 checkpoint persists and Circle Rank stays independent.
Existing Core collectible claim, equip, and Shards award RPCs remain authoritative and unchanged.
Existing Special Character task badges are not replaced by new tangible story-item records.
AdMob native first-view placement, offscreen lifecycle, user consent, and fast Circle Rank/dashboard navigation remain unchanged.
Original uploaded 10 Library collection sheets are preserved unmodified; visual zoom never claims HD resolution or creates official rewards.
No client direct table write for task evidence, story-item awards, QMP, finance or Kingdom Shards.
IGPAT remains retired and no video/Wall/Connect functionality is edited.
acceptanceChecks: All 10 original batch images are independently mapped to exactly 1,300 unique canonical id/level/slot, with every output WebP checked by SHA-256.
No Character stage is marked owned unless its official core redeemed record or authenticated Special story awards explicitly confirms it.
Special badges remain distinct from five story items; server-only task event source attribution and unique award constraints block replay/cross-account assignment.
Full-screen zoom opens on a selected thumbnail with pinch, pan, plus/minus and accessible text; offline/missing-art falls back without loading adjacent content.
Existing Circle Rank and Character V3 levels resume unchanged on switching characters or accounts; no points or revenue mutation.
Art publication marker is served only after 1,300 verified remote objects, using a secret-free app and a guarded operator upload.
Run local SQL validation, TypeScript, new focused tests, existing AdMob/points/navigation release gates before moving beyond isolated DEV.
Do not run production migration, install native packages, build AAB, publish OTA or merge to production without verified RC gates.
Core redeemed-item progress helper must equal restored V3 saved XP plus active BP delta after multiple Character switches; other accounts cannot invoke the private helper.
Rejected/reversed ledger credits cannot count for future task awards; previously issued cosmetics require audit rather than automatic confiscation.
